1937, January
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 163 Cont.
Jan. 23 Gregory Kornbacher - 20 - keeping company with cousin (2nd) against Mothers wishes - and against. ..
24 Theresa Gosselin - 8 - Epileptic fits - 3 or 4 a day often .....
Maurice Guerin - 25 - went to Hamilton San. last October with "gallop- ing consump. Enrolled in S. Mass Asso'n just before Xmas when not expected to live a week - could not raise his hand at - time. Now writes letters to his friends and is astonishing everyone.
Page 164
Jan. 27 Georgina Sopha - 8 mo. - cured of richets - constipation - etc. - has still a rupture.
Cath. Schmidt - 48 - bothered 24 yrs. with hives - Summer the heat causes it and winter the cold almost same thing - sometimes fearful Clara Goodrow - 33 - fell last Wed. and brok'spine. . improving .. .... cast
Jan. 28 Andrew La Prese - 19 - had pneumonia - now clear up but with heart trouble - Enrolled at 10:30 last night % phone - - slept well ....
29 Mrs. Gladys Newberry - 32 - mother of 4 children threatened with goitre operation. Had operation four years ago - was on table four hours - now same thing seems to be returning. Enrolled To-day 50¢ Promising Poor Souls enrollments ... etc.
Bertha Gilmore - 54 - enemia - very serious stomach- a widow with 6 children - now only weighs about 62.
1937, February
Page 165 Feb. Ist Irene Laskos - 15 - Leakage of heart. Enrolled perpetually 3 weeks ago and improved same night - still living to surprise of doctors.
Ist Anna Melvin - 35? - improvement in position - Educational Department
Ist Charles Malburg - 20 - rhumatic "rhumatisme" lucemia - Enrolled last May in S. Mass A. and prayed for in many places. Nothing seems to help - always becoming weaker and more painful. Enrolled again To- day, asks through his friends for prayers.
Frank Vismara - 55 about - ... improving recently-for three weeks hopeless.
